caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular panel with a design featuring stylized botanical elements. Within the panel, yellowish-gold branches with leaves and acorn-like shapes are arranged in a flowing, vertical composition. The leaves have jagged edges, and the acorn shapes are smooth and round with small caps. The background of the panel is rendered in a deep brown color, creating a contrast with the yellow-gold branches and leaves. The entire panel is outlined with a solid black border, and the area outside the panel is a plain, light beige or off-white color with no additional markings or decorations.
title: Painted Glass - Mariner's Church
